{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for new customers reached by paid search
filtered = df[(df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (df['customer_segment'] == 'new')]

# Print the number of rows in the filtered dataset
print(f"Number of new customers reached by paid search: {len(filtered)}")

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of converted orders
conversion_rate = filtered['converted'].mean()

# Print the conversion rate
print(f"Conversion rate among new customers reached by paid search: {conversion_rate}")"}
